about_the_game:
About this Demo:

SeedGod is a strategy-based deck-building game inspired by the classic Minesweeper. In this game, you must choose the best positions to plant your crops, capture bugs, and find tools to strengthen your deck for any challenge.

In this demo, players can access the first playable cycle, where they can choose an initial character and face the lagoon challenge. The demo includes 10 levels of difficulty and over 20 cards to collect.

This demo version will be available until the end of March 2024 and offers approximately 1 hour of active gameplay, challenging players' strategies.

If you encounter any issues, you can report them via email or social media. We would also love to hear your feedback on this preliminary version of what we envision SeedGod to be in the future.

Our goal is to release a more extended version of the demo for everyone to play next Friday, February 28th.

Thank you for giving SeedGod a chance. Happy planting!

short_description: In the SeedGod demo, your mission will be to strategically plant in a bug-filled lagoon. Choose the best positions, and you can discover unique plants, capture bugs, find tools, and access levels that will challenge your survival and planning tactics.
